title: Delete file confirmation dialog can't be clicked with Apple Pencil
reason: Reports Apple Pencil taps failing specifically on the hosted delete-file confirmation in iPad Safari, while finger taps and Pencil interaction elsewhere work. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The hosted account/file confirmation path is absent from Varve; no native or browser pencil reproduction was performed.

title: tldraw.com file load serializes 8–10 network round trips before canvas content renders
reason: Detailed investigation attributes blank-canvas load delay to serialized auth, bootstrap, WebSocket, server lookup, and room hydration steps, including an observed create-file propagation race. Related follow-ups split local caching (#9927) and lower-risk serialization fixes (#9928); this path is the hosted service rather than Varve's desktop local file load.

varveAssessment.assessment: The reported chain depends on Clerk, Zero, Postgres, WebSocket, Durable Objects, and R2; Varve's local-first loading path is different and was not profiled here.

title: Cache file documents locally and hydrate incrementally for instant reload on tldraw.com
reason: Proposes caching hosted board document snapshots locally for immediate rendering and later websocket reconciliation, linked to the latency analysis in #9926. No discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve already has offline-first persistence and different consistency requirements; the upstream cross-device cache proposal should not be transplanted without local recovery/conflict analysis.

title: Cut tldraw.com canvas load time with low-risk serialization fixes
reason: Follow-up to #9926 proposing bounded changes to remove serialized network waits; the reply expresses support. The retrieved discussion does not supply measured post-change latency or deployment status.

varveAssessment.assessment: These optimizations target hosted request sequencing and do not establish Varve startup or local-file latency.

title: Move Cloudflare worker secrets to infrastructure-as-code
reason: Requests versioning Cloudflare worker secret/environment requirements and provisioning instead of ad hoc dashboard management. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not operate those Cloudflare workers; no infrastructure change is implied.

title: Remove no-op renderDebugMenuItems prop and dead shareZone/topZone fields from TldrawUi
reason: Identifies a public UI prop and two UI-zone fields that are accepted then discarded after the upstream component override migration. This is an SDK compatibility/documentation cleanup; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's component override API differs; no analogous no-op public options were audited in this issue review.

title: Add a keyboard shortcut to edit the text label of currently selected arrow
reason: The reporter asks for a shortcut because double-clicking arrow strokes is difficult; a maintainer points out Enter already edits the selected arrow label, and the reporter then asks where this is documented. The follow-up indicates a discoverability/documentation gap rather than a missing command.

varveAssessment.assessment: Compare Varve's selected-arrow Enter action and guidance before treating this as a feature gap; no local shortcut/docs inspection was performed here.

title: Default UI components crash when mounted outside <Tldraw>, with no type error
reason: Reports public default toolbar/quick-action components importing a commenting hook that requires LicenseContext, despite the public UI context provider supporting mounting components without a full editor. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's UI mounting/provider contracts are distinct; no equivalent standalone UI crash was reproduced.

title: @tldraw/mermaid: edge labels render a size smaller than node labels
reason: Reports Mermaid edge labels defaulting to small while nodes default to medium, affecting text size as well as stroke width. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The issue concerns a separate upstream Mermaid plugin; no Varve diagram-label mismatch was tested.

title: Closing a stacked dialog by touch also closes the dialog beneath it
reason: Reports tapping Confirm in a nested dialog dismissing both the nested dialog and its parent, while mouse behavior is correct. The issue gives a real-device/example reproduction but has no discussion.

varveAssessment.assessment: A serious touch event/dismissal regression candidate for nested dialogs; Varve's nested dialog behavior has not been inspected or device-tested.
